editorial.name: CodeSandbox
editorial.descriptionZh: CodeSandbox 把开发环境做成微 VM：调 SDK 就能给 AI agent 或学生几秒内开一个隔离沙箱跑代码，闲置后自动休眠，快照能原样恢复。首屏黑底配荧光绿大字 Sandboxes built for scale，顶上一条被 Together AI 收购的公告。
editorial.takeawayZh: 给 agent 开一个隔离沙箱，几秒跑起任意代码
editorial.noteZh: 首屏上方一条荧光绿横幅写 New CodeSandbox is now part of Together AI! We have joined forces to launch CodeSandbox SDK and bring code interpretation to generative AI.，主视觉是黑底上一行超大的 Sandboxes / built for scale，副标 Programmatically spin up isolated sandboxes for instant code execution in your AI agents and code playgrounds.。Secure code generation at scale 段列六张能力卡：Powerful APIs、Secure & isolated、Ready for scale（声称可撑 millions of concurrent VMs）、Continuous context（靠快照恢复）、Quick start & auto resume（2 秒内启动、克隆、还原）、Customizable hibernation。Built for AI agents and more 段按 AI agents、Development environments at scale、Secure code interpretation & evals、CI/CD 四类讲，末尾是 Template universe 与 Start with your favorite stack. 两节。客户 logo 有 algolia、Microsoft、intel、NVIDIA、ATLASSIAN、Uber。

reasons.statement: 首屏 SDK 卖点、六张能力卡与用例分栏都在介绍 CodeSandbox 自家的沙箱服务，属于产品与公司官网；候选池来自 saaslandingpage.com 的落地页灵感。
